title: Jesus... I Keep Waiting To Feel Ready To Start. ⏳
topic: she keeps waiting to feel ready to start the project she has planned for weeks, one more tutorial instead of the first try

bible.text: He that observeth the wind shall not sow; and he that regardeth the clouds shall not reap.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: Jesus... I keep waiting to feel ready before I start.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: Three weeks of tutorials. The project file? Still empty. My notes look amazing though.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: You're not waiting for readiness. You're waiting for a day with no wind.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: If I start and it's bad, then I'm someone who's bad at it.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: The farmer doesn't ask the clouds to clear before he sows. A seed in the ground is already ahead of a seed in the packet.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: Start small and imperfect today. Sowing was never the reward step. It's the brave one.

lines.speaker: engagement
lines.text: Send this to the friend still waiting to feel ready. ⏳
